newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Asahimas to increases glass prices.
newsitem.headline: Asahimas to increases glass prices.

text.p: Indonesian glass maker PT Asahimas Flat Glass said on Wednesday it planned to raise domestic prices for some of its glass products by between 10 and 15 percent.
The company said in a statement the move was principally an effort to bridge the gap between domestic and international prices.
"The domestic market for commodity glass has recently shown signs of recovery which are expected to extend in 1997," Asahimas said.
It said the new prices would be effective from January 1.
